scope: Live desktop browser observations retained from the Sunday Funday audit. RecordedOn is the date these notes were retained, not a fabricated per-page timestamp. The checks did not verify full game completions, mobile play, payouts or deployed source revisions.
environment: Cloud browser desktop session; Aletheon reported WebGL2 unavailable in that environment.

games.summary: A Klondike deal loaded with visible cards and controls.
details: Eleven variants, keyboard help, undo and a move log were visible.
No completed game was checked.

games.summary: The practice interface loaded; the revenue-sharing banner was not verified.
details: The page advertised ad sales and shared revenue while the catalog described practice-only play.
No real-money settlement, payout or full practice run was checked.

games.summary: The live page is titled the Gnaw. A guest delve and attack worked.
details: The first reach and a husk-moth encounter were visible, with Attack, Descend and Retreat choices.
The store displayed paid boost prices alongside mock, stripe(off) and hive(off) provider labels. No purchase was attempted.
actions: Used Attack in the first encounter.

games.summary: TileSlots opened to a name-entry screen.
details: No player identity was created, so the game beyond that entry screen was not checked.

games.summary: A graph merge changed the energy cost; Undo restored the prior state.
details: The starting screen exposed 131 legal-move buttons with little guidance about the player goal.
One merge cost 31 energy; Undo restored 0 energy and 131 moves.

games.summary: The production graph and its controls loaded.
details: Save, import, pause and replay controls were visible.
A complete production cycle and save recovery were not checked.

games.summary: New game produced a 9×9 board; the inspected desktop layout overflowed horizontally.
details: The board was initially blank while the page initialized.
Five bot choices were visible. A completed game was not checked.

games.summary: The daily entry screen loaded and disclosed one scored attempt.
details: The observed entry described a six-floor daily run.
The scored attempt was not consumed. No completion, payout or practice route was verified.

games.summary: The HUD loaded, but the game view stayed uniformly green in this browser check.
details: The seed and four-demon HUD initialized without a visible game world.
The page selected a scored daily run and described automatic submission. No successful play or score submission was verified.

games.summary: The town did not connect; the page reported “The connection is closed.”
details: The view remained at “Coming ashore…” / “Connecting…” with a blank world and map.
A Reconnect control was visible. This records the failed browser entry, separately from whether the HTML page was reachable.

games.summary: This browser reported WebGL2 unavailable; world entry was not verified.
details: The name-entry screen was visible.
The page mentioned a 2D fallback but required WebGL2 to walk. This is a limitation of the inspected environment, not a claim that the service is unavailable to every browser.

games.summary: The live view was mostly dark and a death appeared before useful play.
details: The observed live canvas had a dark field with a green strip near the bottom.
A death appeared at about 2.4 seconds and no retry control was visible. Later local source repairs are not evidence that this public route has changed.

games.summary: The entry page explicitly said “casino.561.group is not open yet.”
details: No blackjack table or playable round was available in this check.
No account, payment or wager was attempted.

games.summary: The race setup loaded with one to four human or bot players.
details: Daily and practice choices were visible.
No completed race was checked.

games.summary: The course opened with rooms, checks and three perspective lenses.
details: Seven rooms and thirty checks were presented; the unavailable Lakotaean material was explicitly labeled.
No completed course was checked.

details: No completed game was checked.

details: The page disclosed practice-only play.
